mapper.select:
SELECT op.id, op.code, op.name, op.auth_status, op.auth_time, op.auth_json, opw.id as detailId, opw.create_time, opw.update_time, opw.create_user_name, opw.create_user_id, opw.update_user_name, opw.update_user_id, opw.version, opw.is_deleted, opw.main_id, opw.platform_warehouse_code, opw.platform_warehouse_name, opw.country, opw.country_name, opw.warehouse_id, opw.warehouse_name, opw.warehouse_code, opw.disabled FROM overseas_provider_warehouse as opw LEFT JOIN overseas_provider as op ON opw.main_id = op.id WHERE op.is_deleted = FALSE AND opw.is_deleted = FALSE AND opw.disabled = FALSE and auth_status = 'already'
AND opw.warehouse_id != ''
